exact_claim_text: Within the declared synthetic tasks, the prototype prevents the tested invalid and duplicate submissions and preserves a recoverable audit path more consistently than the manual baseline.
method_or_source: Manual shared-folder baseline versus the prototype under the same synthetic task set, including invalid, duplicate and interrupted submissions.
uncertainty: Limited task coverage, implementation defects, laboratory environment and absence of real users or adversarial security testing.
boundary: Local prototype, synthetic files and controlled tasks; no production deployment, security certification or universal usability claim.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: The interrupted-upload case required manual recovery and one accessibility defect remained open.
stronger_wording_rejected: The prototype is ready for institutional production use.
